label: JONAPWD 2025
definition: An assumption, not a count: the global 15% disability rate applied to 2025 population projections. Nobody was counted.
source: Joint National Association of Persons with Disabilities (JONAPWD), 2025 Assumptive Disability Disaggregated Data

label: WHO global estimate
definition: WHO: “An estimated 1.3 billion people experience significant disability… 16% of the world’s population”. The fact sheet does not define “significant disability” or cite a source report for the figure, so it is not a Washington Group cut-off figure.
source: World Health Organization, fact sheet “Disability”, 7 March 2023
